title: torch.compile the model with a fixed padded length per bucket
description: Profiling: compiled step 53 ms vs 92 ms eager at bs 256 x 278, compile ~17 s. Compile the model once; to avoid recompiles per distinct batch length, round each batch's T up to a multiple of 32 (dynamic=False, few shapes).
hypothesis: ~1.7x steps/s for ~17 s of budget spent compiling. A handful of distinct shapes cost a few recompiles each ~10 s; rounding to 32 keeps it to about 8 shapes.
